name: suspicious_signin
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != 0
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress,
          AppDisplayName, ResultDescription

name: impossible_travel
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
    Locations=make_set(Location)
    by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where array_length(Locations) > 1

name: multiple_failed_signins
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != 0
| summarize FailedAttempts=count()
    by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where FailedAttempts >= 10

name: privileged_role_assignment
query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName has_any (
    "Add member to role",
    "Add eligible member to role",
    "Add permanent member to role"
)
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatedBy,
          TargetResources, OperationName

name: sensitive_file_access
query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType has_any (
    "FileDownloaded",
    "FileAccessed",
    "FileUploaded"
)
| where ObjectName has_any (
    "password",
    "credential",
    "secret",
    "confidential"
)
| project TimeGenerated, AccountDisplayName,
          ActionType, ObjectName

name: mailbox_forwarding_rule
query:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation has_any (
    "New-InboxRule",
    "Set-InboxRule"
)
| where Parameters has_any (
    "ForwardTo",
    "RedirectTo",
    "ForwardAsAttachmentTo"
)
| project TimeGenerated, UserId,
          Operation, Parameters

name: azure_resource_change
query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue == "Succeeded"
| where OperationNameValue has_any (
    "write",
    "delete",
    "action"
)
| project TimeGenerated, Caller,
          OperationNameValue, ResourceGroup, Resource

name: defender_high_severity_alert
query:
AlertInfo
| where Severity in ("High", "Critical")
| project Timestamp, AlertId,
          Title, Severity, Category

name: suspicious_dns_query
query:
DnsEvents
| where QueryName has_any (
    ".xyz",
    ".top",
    ".click",
    ".zip",
    ".mov"
)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer,
          ClientIP, Name, QueryType

name: sensitive_label_access
query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType has_any (
    "FileDownloaded",
    "FileAccessed",
    "FileUploaded"
)
| where SensitivityLabel contains "Confidential"
| project TimeGenerated,
          AccountDisplayName,
          ActionType,
          ObjectName,
          SensitivityLabel
